name: Four in a Row
hook: Drop discs, block your friend, line up four.
how: Take turns dropping a disc into one of seven columns; the first to get four in a line across, down or diagonally wins. The first two players take the seats; anyone else watches and takes the loser's seat next game. Alone? A bot plays the other side.
controls: Click or tap a column (or press 1–7) to drop a disc
uses: The host's browser checks every drop; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot takes any empty seat, so you can play alone, and a friend who joins takes the bot's side.
Players and watchers see the same board, and you see your opponent's disc hover before it drops.
Most wins, shown after every game.
ideas: Make the board 9 wide and 5 to win
Add a 15-second timer for each turn
Turn the discs into cookies and the board into an oven tray
